facts: A box plot marks five values: the **minimum**, $Q_1$, the **median** ($Q_2$), $Q_3$ and the **maximum**.
The **box** runs from $Q_1$ to $Q_3$, with a line at the median. It shows the middle half of the ordered data.
The **left whisker** runs from the minimum to $Q_1$, and the **right whisker** from $Q_3$ to the maximum.
A box plot needs only a numeric axis in the data's units — there is no frequency axis, because it shows no individual values.
Quartiles mark about $25\%$, $50\%$ and $75\%$ of the way through ordered data. Repeated values can affect the exact numbers below or above these values.
The median line need not be halfway across the box. Quartile sections can have different widths on the number line.
steps: Draw and scale a number line that comfortably fits the minimum to the maximum.
Mark the minimum and maximum with a short vertical whisker end.
Draw a line inside the box at the median.
Join each whisker end to the nearest edge of the box.

workedExamples.question_text: The ordered scores are $12,17,19,22,25,28,31,35,x$. The last score is the maximum, and the range is $30$. Find the missing maximum and state the five-number summary.
workedExamples.solution_text:
The maximum is the minimum plus the range.
$\begin{aligned}x&=12+30\\&=42\end{aligned}$
The full ordered list is $12,17,19,22,25,28,31,35,42$.
The median is the fifth value, $25$. Disregard it when finding the quartiles.
The lower half is $12,17,19,22$; the upper half is $28,31,35,42$.
$\begin{aligned}Q_1&=\frac{17+19}{2}\\&=18\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}Q_3&=\frac{31+35}{2}\\&=33\end{aligned}$
Five-number summary: minimum $=12$, $Q_1=18$, median $=25$, $Q_3=33$, maximum $=42$.

foundation.solution_text: The box runs from $Q_1$ to $Q_3$, showing the middle half of the ordered data.

development.solution_text:
A whisker joins a box edge to an extreme value.
The left whisker runs from the minimum up to $Q_1$, the left edge of the box.

mastery.question_text:
A swimmer's start reaction times, in milliseconds, are listed in order:
$220, 235, 245, 250, 255, 265, 270, 280, x$.
The last value has been omitted. The range is $90$ ms.
Find the maximum reaction time, then state the full five-number summary.
mastery.solution_text:
Range $=$ maximum $-$ minimum.
Maximum $=220+90=310$ ms.
The full ordered list is $220, 235, 245, 250, 255, 265, 270, 280, 310$.
The median is the fifth value, $255$.
Disregard the median. The lower half is $220, 235, 245, 250$, so $Q_1=(235+245)\div 2=240$.
The upper half is $265, 270, 280, 310$, so $Q_3=(270+280)\div 2=275$.
Five-number summary: minimum $=220$, $Q_1=240$, median $=255$, $Q_3=275$, maximum $=310$.
